english.title: Movement Enhance
english.description:
This mod grants a global movement bonus to all units controlled by human players.
Once enabled, every unit owned by a human player receives 1 Movement. AI players are not affected.

schinese.title: 人类单位移动力增强
schinese.description:
本 Mod 为人类玩家提供全局单位移动力加成。
启用后，所有由人类玩家控制的单位将额外获得 1 点移动力。该效果不会影响 AI 玩家。
